symptoms: HikariPool active connections reached max, idle dropped to zero, requests waited for connections, slow order_history customer_reference query
validated_diagnosis: A slow order_history query exhausted the application connection pool while the database remained available.
evidence_summary: Pool saturation correlated with a 48-second query; database health was UP; query plan showed a sequential scan.
resolution: Added an index supporting customer_reference and tuned the query; pool waiters returned to zero.

symptoms: SQL connection failures and Hikari acquisition timeouts across all endpoints
validated_diagnosis: The PostgreSQL instance was temporarily unavailable during infrastructure maintenance.
evidence_summary: Database health checks failed and infrastructure events showed a restart during the incident.
resolution: Database service recovered and connection acquisition normalized.

symptoms: HTTP timeouts, executor queue full, no database connection errors
validated_diagnosis: A blocked external API caused request threads to accumulate until the executor queue filled.
evidence_summary: Thread dumps and outbound latency metrics confirmed blocked calls.
resolution: Added dependency timeout and circuit breaker.
